connections.description: External connections, one values layer per projects/<project>/connections/<name>.yaml. This chart consumes none.

okdp-lib-chart.description: Values slot Helm creates for the okdp-lib-chart library dependency. Not a parameter.

jobNamespaces.title: Job namespaces
jobNamespaces.description: List of namespaces where Spark jobs can run. If empty string is included, all namespaces will be allowed

webhookEnabled.title: Admission webhook
webhookEnabled.description: Enable admission webhook for validation and mutation

upstream.title: Upstream chart values
upstream.description: Values of the upstream chart this chart renders, merged over the values it computes: any upstream parameter can be set, except the ones the platform relies on. Maps merge, lists and scalars replace. No key or value may contain '{{'.

spark-operator.title: spark-operator
spark-operator.description: Values of the spark-operator chart 2.5.2 (https://kubeflow.github.io/spark-operator), for example image, controller/webhook resources, nodeSelector, tolerations, env, batchScheduler, uiIngress. Refused: fullnameOverride, nameOverride, hook, certManager, spark.jobNamespaces, spark.serviceAccount.create, spark.rbac.create, controller.rbac.create, controller.serviceAccount.create, webhook.rbac.create, webhook.serviceAccount.create. Appended to the lists this chart sets: controller/webhook volumes and volumeMounts.

noTemplate.description: No key or string value, at any depth, contains '{{': upstream charts pass some values to tpl.
